加入房间时推送播放、设置、队列和成员快照。

-- response --
{
  "version": 1,
  "kind": "event",
  "type": "playback.updated",
  "data": {
    "song": null,
    "startedAtMs": 0,
    "user": null,
    "volumeCoefficient": 1
  }
}

-- response --
{
  "version": 1,
  "kind": "event",
  "type": "settings.updated",
  "data": {
    "playMode": "sequential"
  }
}

-- response --
{
  "version": 1,
  "kind": "event",
  "type": "queue.updated",
  "data": {
    "current": null,
    "items": [],
    "onlineCount": 1
  }
}

-- response --
{
  "version": 1,
  "kind": "event",
  "type": "members.updated",
  "data": {
    "onlineCount": 1,
    "users": [
      {
        "name": "游客(127.0.*.*)",
        "emailHash": ""
      }
    ]
  }
}
